procedures: Original trial prefixes verified from reset; accept exactly the native successful return hold, exclude abort and later emergency-stop. No extra dwell before GRASP.

Prospective fresh fixture Cartesian command endpoints are fixed by the controlled bench, with the same registered downward arm and native visual-servo schedule, joint limits, Cartesian reference and gripper. Each starts at an open reset with a fixed -0.8 rad joint1, 120 native settle ticks, then calls all eight skills continuously. No resetting at junctions.

Both refused original cases use their observed namespace for shape and initial pose, their archived servo prefix and native target resolution. Grasp close executes 240 ticks with original slide force and residual joint speed. Lift/retreat command is vertical current XY, Z=max(0.16,current.z+0.10) from original registered resolver. Transfer/preplace on the supervised isolated bench uses registered region centre and measured source grasp height. Motion calibrator supplies fixed endpoints from current commanded skills to native VisualServoSession, does not score end-to-end vision.

Save original RGB-D exposure when available and dedicated frozen camera renders of actual mechanical state at every junction, no new integration tick. Plot-free native records, no segmentation used by control.

Save all normal steps, prior/following 8-step window, every halt offset 0..8, original emergency_stop and 240 actual subsequent steps with gripper open/closed unchanged as controlled by native stop. Brake full-state integration offline after acquisition. Classify allowed finger/workpiece only during planned contact and endpoint table support.

Retain force and contact positions, full relative transform, body COM mass/inertia and workpiece bottom. Require bilateral normal force/physical contact, at least 50 mm ascent and 120 uninterrupted ticks of stable bilateral hold. Verify release and settled placement in registered region from actual final 120 steps; no incoming phase for a failed/open predecessor.

Record open/closed target, joint command finite-difference and direction, q/dq and phase at each handoff so a reader can leave uncovered combinations fail-closed. These fresh seeds are independent of rejected t01/t02 and of optical candidate-wide offset grid.
provenance_limits: Developing a physical continuity and braking calibration with measured-state images and recorded original prefixes. Entire trajectories split before capture; two formal-score slots sealed. No new independent score, real hardware, formal trials or autonomous online assertions.
